goal: Scaffold the project and build the Liquid Glass material system, desktop, transparent menu bar with Apple + dynamic per-app menus and focus tracking, Dock, window manager, and theming — proven end-to-end with one stub app.
summary:
Phase 1 (Foundation & Liquid Glass Shell) complete. All 6 steps done and verified.

Built end-to-end:
- **Scaffold** (Step 1): Vite 8 + React 19 + TS 6 + Tailwind v4 + Framer Motion 13 + oxlint; `@/` path aliases; folder structure.
- **Liquid Glass material system** (Step 2): `GlassSurface` component (backdrop-filter blur/saturate + translucent layers + specular highlights + sheen), `theme.css` with light/dark/accent CSS variables, `ThemeProvider` setting data-theme/data-accent/.reduce-transparency on <html>. Reduce Transparency flattens all glass to near-opaque.
- **Desktop + menu bar** (Step 3): full-screen wallpaper, transparent Liquid Glass menu bar (Apple logo + focused-app name + per-app menus + status glyphs + live clock), full menu data model (AppMenu/MenuAction/separators/shortcuts/submenus), dropdown+submenu renderer with hover-switch + click-outside/Escape, working Apple menu (About This Mac sheet, System Settings, Sleep/Restart/Shut Down, Lock Screen).
- **Window manager** (Step 4): draggable title bar (pointer-capture), traffic-light buttons (close/min/zoom with hover symbols), 8 resize handles (edges + corners), maximize/minimize/restore, z-order focus, click-to-front → menu bar re-titles to the focused app's name + menus.
- **Dock** (Step 5): Liquid Glass capsule, Framer Motion magnification (smoothstep curve, spring-animated), click-to-launch (opens new window or focuses/restores existing), running indicator dots (accent=focused, gray=open, transparent=closed), all 14 apps in the registry with gradient SF-style icons.
- **Theming** (Step 6): `ThemePanel` (dark-mode toggle, 7-accent picker, Reduce Transparency toggle) wired to the menu bar's Control Center icon; since all glass surfaces read CSS vars from <html>, any toggle re-tints the entire app instantly.

Verification:
- `pnpm build` → exit 0; 440 modules (348.62 kB JS / 11.44 kB CSS).
- `pnpm exec oxlint` → 0 warnings, 0 errors (26 files).
- `pnpm dev` → boots on http://localhost:5173 in ~140ms.
- All modules transform cleanly (verified via dev-server HTTP fetches across steps).

The shell is a functional macOS Tahoe foundation: desktop, transparent menu bar with working Apple + per-app menus, draggable/resizable windows, Liquid Glass Dock with magnification, and live theming. Phase 2 builds the 5 OS overlays on top of this; Phase 3 fills in the 14 apps' real content.
stepSummaries:
1. Scaffold Vite + React + TS; add Tailwind, Framer Motion, ESLint, path aliases, and folder structure. Manual: dev server boots to a blank page. [verified]
  2. Build reusable Liquid Glass material system: a <GlassSurface> component using backdrop-filter blur/saturate + translucent layers + specular highlights; CSS theme variables; a Reduce Transparency flat variant. Manual: a glass panel renders translucent over the wallpaper. [verified]
  3. Desktop + wallpaper + transparent menu bar: full-screen desktop, wallpaper layer, transparent top bar with Apple logo, focus-driven active-app name, and a menu data model + dropdown/submenu renderer. [verified]
  4. Window manager: draggable/resizable/min/max/close windows, z-order focus, and focus→menu-bar app-name + menus update. [verified]
  5. Liquid Glass Dock with Framer Motion magnification; an app registry; one stub app opens from the Dock. [verified]
  6. Theming: light/dark + accent-color tints via CSS vars app-wide; Reduce Transparency toggle flattens effects. Manual: toggle dark mode and observe Dock/menus re-tint. [verified]
